runtime.title: FlareSolverr clearance
runtime.description: Disabled by default. Used to obtain clearance after an upstream request is blocked by Cloudflare, and can be combined with a WARP / Privoxy proxy chain for retries.
runtime.priorityNote: Proxy priority: account proxy > FlareSolverr proxy chain > explicit proxy > global proxy. Cookie / cf_clearance values are never returned in plaintext in API responses.
runtime.dockerWarning: Before using FlareSolverr mode, start the flaresolverr, privoxy, and warp-proxy containers via Docker first; the in-container URL is usually http://flaresolverr:8191.

egressMode.label: Egress mode
egressMode.hint: The WARP compose setup uses single_proxy by default.

proxyUrl.label: Clearance proxy URL
proxyUrl.hint: Supports http/https/socks5/socks5h; socks5 is converted to socks5h. Authenticated format: scheme://account:password@host:port, or paste host:port:account:password directly.

resourceProxyUrl.label: Resource proxy URL
resourceProxyUrl.placeholder: Leave blank to reuse the clearance proxy

resetStatusCodes.label: Session reset status codes
resetStatusCodes.hint: Defaults to 403; only triggers on Cloudflare / challenge-type errors.

manualCookieHint.stored: The server already has a saved Cookie/clearance; saving with this blank will not clear the existing value.
manualCookieHint.empty: Leave blank to skip using a manual cookie.

clearance.cfClearancePlaceholder: Optional: enter only the cf_clearance value

toasts.testProxyFailed: Failed to test the clearance proxy

toasts.loadFailed: Failed to load the proxy configuration
toasts.enableRequiresUrl: A proxy address is required when the proxy is enabled

fields.urlHint: Leave blank to skip using a proxy. Enter the full address, for example `http://127.0.0.1:7890`, `http://username:password@127.0.0.1:7890`, or `socks5://127.0.0.1:7890`.

header.title: R2 backup management
header.description: Back up key data to Cloudflare R2 on a schedule, with optional encryption, rotation, manual runs, and history cleanup.

backup.banner: Accounts and user keys are exported as a logical snapshot from the current storage backend, regardless of whether the underlying store is `json`, `sqlite`, `postgres`, or `git`. The image directory is not backed up by default, to avoid an oversized backup.

prefix.label: Backup prefix
prefix.hint: Object key prefix within R2, for example `backups/prod`.

intervalMinutes.label: Scheduled backup interval
intervalMinutes.hint: In minutes; the service polls and runs automatically at this interval after startup.

rotationKeep.label: Number of backups to keep
rotationKeep.hint: Older backups are automatically deleted after a successful upload. Enter `0` to disable automatic rotation.

passphrase.label: Encryption passphrase
passphrase.hint: Used only when encryption is enabled. Keep it safe, or the backup contents cannot be decrypted.

include.title: Backup contents
include.description: Check the components whose data should go into the backup package.

history.title: Backup history
history.description: View object information and delete remote backups directly.
history.empty: No remote backup records yet. They will appear here after you save the configuration and run a manual backup.

detail.title: Backup details
detail.empty: Backup details cannot be read right now; if this is an encrypted backup, make sure the correct passphrase is entered and the configuration is saved first.

toasts.authExpired: Your session has expired; please sign in again before downloading
toasts.reauthRequired: Your session has expired; please sign in again and retry
toasts.loadFailed: Failed to load the backup list
toasts.testFailed: Failed to test the backup connection

core.banner: The admin login key continues to be read from the deployment configuration and is no longer shown on this page; to share access with someone else, create a regular user key below.

refreshInterval.label: Account refresh interval
refreshInterval.hint: In minutes; controls how often accounts refresh automatically.

proxy.label: Global proxy
proxy.hint: Leave blank to disable the proxy. Supports scheme://account:password@host:port, or paste host:port:account:password directly from a provider; example: http://user:pass@127.0.0.1:7890, 127.0.0.1:7890:user:pass. URL-encode the account or password if it contains special characters such as @ or :.

imageBaseUrl.label: Image access URL
imageBaseUrl.hint: The access URL prefix used when generating image results.

defaultUpstreamModel.label: Default upstream model name for requests
defaultUpstreamModel.hint: The upstream model name used when gpt-image-2 sends an image request; defaults to gpt-5-5.

defaultThinkingEffort.label: Default thinking effort
defaultThinkingEffort.hint: When the model name ends with -standard, -extended or -max, the model suffix takes priority.

imageRetentionDays.label: Automatic image cleanup
imageRetentionDays.hint: Automatically deletes local images older than this many days.

imagePollTimeout.label: Image polling timeout
imagePollTimeout.hint: In seconds; the maximum time to wait for the upstream image result.

imageAccountConcurrency.label: Per-account image concurrency
imageAccountConcurrency.hint: Limits how many image requests each account handles at the same time; defaults to 3.

autoRemoveInvalidAccounts.label: Automatically remove invalid accounts
autoRemoveInvalidAccounts.hint: Detects and removes them during refresh

imageSettleEnabled.label: Image confirmation pass
imageSettleEnabled.hint: Turning this on slightly improves the success rate of fetching images.

imageRemoveConversationAfterResult.label: Remove local conversation after an image
imageRemoveConversationAfterResult.hint: After an image is retrieved successfully, asynchronously hides the matching local conversation on the ChatGPT side.

imageRemoveConversationAlways.label: Remove local conversation even without an image
imageRemoveConversationAlways.hint: Also hides the conversation on failure, timeout, or a text-only response (this includes cases where the image succeeded once enabled).

imageTimeoutRetrySecs.label: Extra wait time after an image timeout
imageTimeoutRetrySecs.hint: In seconds; the extra time to wait after clicking "Keep waiting" once the timeout is reached.

imageSettleSecs.label: Image confirmation wait time
imageSettleSecs.hint: In seconds; how long to wait before re-confirming after an image is found. Requires the image confirmation pass to be enabled.

autoReloginAfterRefresh.label: Automatically retry recovering an abnormal state after refresh
autoReloginAfterRefresh.hint: When enabled, automatically retries logging in with the password to recover the account during refresh.

logLevel.label: Console log level
logLevel.hint: Defaults to info / warning / error when none are selected.

globalSystemPrompt.label: Global extra instructions
globalSystemPrompt.placeholder: Example: first check whether the user prompt is compliant; refuse requests involving illegal, sexual, violent, or hateful content.
globalSystemPrompt.hint: Injected as a system message on every request; useful for reviewing user prompts, avoiding disallowed content, enforcing consistent model behavior, or fixing a persona.

sensitiveWords.label: Sensitive words
sensitiveWords.placeholder: One per line; any match is refused
sensitiveWords.hint: The request is refused outright if it contains any sensitive word.

imageStorage.syncHint: Generation only processes new images; full sync uploads existing local images to WebDAV.
imageStorage.modeSaveHint: Click save after changing this, or it saves automatically via the test/sync buttons.

publicBaseUrl.label: Public access prefix
publicBaseUrl.hint: Leave blank to return this app's /images/... proxy address; fill it in to return the public image address directly.

aiReview.hint: When enabled, a review model is called before a request reaches an image account; requests that fail review are refused outright, reducing the risk of disallowed prompts reaching an account and triggering risk control or a ban.

prompt.label: Review prompt
prompt.placeholder: Decide whether the user's request is allowed. Answer only ALLOW or REJECT.

header.title: Sub2API connection management
header.description: After configuring a Sub2API server, you can query its OpenAI OAuth accounts and bulk-import them into the local account pool.

empty.title: No Sub2API connections yet
empty.description: Click "Add connection" to save your Sub2API info.

help.title: How to use
help.step1: Enter the Sub2API address and admin account (or Admin API Key), then save it as a connection.
help.step2: Clicking "Sync" on a connection fetches its account list filtered by platform=openai and type=oauth.
help.step3: After you check the accounts you need, the backend fetches their access_token concurrently, then auto-imports them into the local account pool and refreshes their status.
help.step4: Only the access_token from the sub2api credentials is read; fields such as refresh_token are never written locally.

header.title: CPA connection management
header.description: Configure a connection first, then query remote accounts as needed and choose which ones to import into the local account pool.

empty.title: No CPA connections yet
empty.description: Click "Add connection" to save your CLIProxyAPI info.

help.title: How to use
help.step1: When the page loads, it first reads the CPA connections already configured in the system.
help.step2: Clicking "Sync" on a connection first reads the remote account list and shows it for you to choose from.
help.step3: After you confirm the selection, the backend downloads the corresponding access_token in the background and imports it into the local account pool.
help.step4: The frontend only polls the import progress and does not participate in the download directly.
